Contract CoCoMEOrderProducts::chooseSupplier(supplierID: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		supplier: Supplier = Supplier.allInstance()->any(s|s.id = supplierID),
		suppliers: Set(Supplier) = Supplier.allInstance()->select(s|s.id = supplierID)
	precondition:
		suppliers.isEmpty() = false and
		self.currentOrderProduct.oclIsUndefined() = false
	postcondition:
		ClassName.allInstance()->includes(currentOrderProduct) and
		self.currentOrderProduct.supplier = supplier and
		result = true
}
